items.source: By default, tests annotated with JsonTest will also initialize JacksonTester, JsonbTester and GsonTester fields. More fine-grained control can be provided through the @AutoConfigureJsonTesters annotation.
items.translation: 默认情况下，带有 JsonTest 注解的测试也会初始化 JacksonTester、JsonbTester 和 GsonTester 字段。可以通过 @AutoConfigureJsonTesters 注解提供更细粒度的控制。

items.source: Properties in form key=value that should be added to the Spring Environment before the test runs.
items.translation: 要在测试运行之前添加到 Spring Environment 的 form key=value 格式的属性。

items.source: Auto-configuration exclusions that should be applied for this test.
items.translation: 应应用于此测试的自动配置排除项。

items.source:
A set of exclude filters which can be used to filter beans that would otherwise be
added to the application context.
items.translation: 一组排除过滤器，可用于过滤本应添加到应用上下文的 Bean。

items.source:
A set of include filters which can be used to add otherwise filtered beans to the
application context.
items.translation: 一组包含过滤器，可用于将其他过滤器排除的 bean 添加到应用程序上下文中。

items.source: When using JUnit 4, this annotation should be used in combination with @RunWith(SpringRunner.class).
items.translation: 在使用 JUnit 4 时，此注解应与 @RunWith(SpringRunner.class) 结合使用。
